connector.name: hypruse
connector.registryDescription: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package hypruse. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
env.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

env.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
env.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

env.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
env.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

env.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
env.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

env.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
env.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

env.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
env.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

env.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
env.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.
